guarantees.claim: On asynchronous reset (negedge rst_ni), msgfifo_empty_q and msgfifo_full_seen_q are forced to 0. When rst_ni is high, on posedge clk_i they are updated to msgfifo_empty and msgfifo_full_seen_d respectively.
guarantees.cond: negedge rst_ni or posedge clk_i with rst_ni high

assumptions.claim: msgfifo_empty and msgfifo_full_seen_d must be stable around posedge clk_i to satisfy register setup/hold timing.
assumptions.risk: If signals change asynchronously, captured values may be metastable or wrong, leading to incorrect FIFO status interpretation (e.g., reading empty FIFO or missing full condition).
